rows.note: Use 兩倍 as the all-purpose noun for a quantity, amount, or size that is twice as much.

example.english: This new computer's storage capacity is double that of the old one.
example.traditional: 呢部新電腦嘅容量係舊嗰部嘅兩倍。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 nou5 ge3 jung4 loeng6 hai6 gau6 go2 bou6 ge3 loeng5 bui3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for an amount that is twice as large.

example.english: We have to pay double rent.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bei2 soeng1 bui3 zou1 gam1

rows.note: Use this when an amount or size becomes twice as large; it is the all-purpose spoken choice for this sense.

example.english: The rent will double this year.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 zou1 gam1 faan1 bui3 laa3

rows.note: Use 雙 + N for things made for or consisting of two matching items, including 雙門 and 雙人房.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 jau5 soeng1 jan4 fong2

rows.note: Use this when actively multiplying an amount by two, such as earnings or a quantity.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 zoeng2 gam1 gaa1 bui3

rows.note: Use this specifically when something has two layers, especially when folded or built in layers.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 saam1 man4 zi6 hai6 soeng1 cang4 gaa3

rows.note: Use 孖份 when ordering a drink made with two measures of alcohol.

example.english: I’ll have a whisky, double, please.
example.traditional: 我要杯威士忌，孖份，唔該。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 bui1 wai1 si6 gei6 maa1 fan6 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use 替身 for a person who resembles another person and stands in for them.

example.english: When filming dangerous scenes, actors use a double.
example.traditional: 拍危險場面時，演員會用替身。
example.jyutping: paak3 ngai4 him2 coeng4 min6 si4 jin2 jyun4 wui5 jung6 tai3 san1

rows.note: Use this construction when one object serves as another object or has another practical use.

example.english: This stool can double as a table.
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 dang3 ho2 ji5 dong3 toi2 jung6

rows.note: Use this for something having two aspects or interpretations, such as a double meaning.

example.english: This sentence has a double meaning.
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 jau5 soeng1 cung4 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this for folding material twice to create two folds.

example.english: Just fold the paper twice to make a double fold.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 zip3 loeng5 zip3 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use 重複品 for an identical extra item, especially when discussing collections or catalogues.

example.english: The catalogue marks this item as a double.
example.traditional: 呢件藏品喺目錄入面標示為重複品。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 cong4 ban2 hai2 muk6 luk6 jap6 min6 biu1 si6 wai4 cung4 fuk1 ban2
